svg.title: By Rank 24, the Machine Cannot Be Filled
svg.desc: A fixed 32 GB budget halves the resident workgroup pool as rank increases. Five gfx950 device maps show the pool shrinking from 2,048 workgroups at rank 20 to 168 workgroups at rank 24, leaving 88 of 256 CUs without a resident workgroup.
svg.text: By Rank 24, the Machine Cannot Be Filled
12 bytes per amplitude against a 32 GB budget — each qubit halves the resident pool

g.text: const uint64_t bytes_per_wg = amp * sizeof(GpuComplex) + (amp/2) * sizeof(GpuComplex);
if (wgs < 1) wgs = 1; // rank 26+: at least one

svg.text: floor of 1 — rank 26 is possible, not fast
round down to a multiple of kNumXCDs = 8
a slice plus a half-size scratch
round down to a multiple of kNumXCDs = 8 so the
resident pool spreads evenly across the compute dies —
Five predictions, five exact matches. This is structural, not incidental — it follows
from the budget constant and the rank, both known before the kernel launches.
First of two independent mechanisms — see rank22-spill-cliff.svg for the second.
